data_fields.name: item_chance_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: TreasureDeath.ItemChance; category passes when Next(1,100) <= value

data_fields.name: mundane_item_chance_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: TreasureDeath.MundaneItemChance; gate also guards the addon roll

data_fields.name: tier
data_fields.donor_constant: TreasureDeath.Tier; tier <= 4 selects coalesced mana addon, 5+ aetheria

data_fields.name: addon_pass_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.02 (coalesced mana, and aetheria after the rate divide)

data_fields.name: looting_window_s
data_fields.donor_constant: Corpse.HalfLife = 180 (comment says half decay time; code is absolute)

best_idea: Roll each drop category once per kill with its own integer percent chance and inclusive count range, then pick from weighted tables, all on the server at the moment the kill is verified.
decision_why: Keep the three-gate shape and the weighted table as zone data; the looting window and the top-damager owner rule are separate choices, not adopted here.
acceptance: A seeded server test: item chance 100 with min=max=2 yields exactly two item drops per kill, chance 0 yields none, and a second looter cannot take the corpse before the window opens and can after it.
